purpose: Compare Azami present environmental state-space sorting with EAzami environmental trajectory dynamics through dated trait-transition windows without an all-BIOCLIM fishing screen.

conceptual_novelty.azami: environmental state space: where continuous capitulum phenotypes are sorted along present-day environmental gradients
conceptual_novelty.eazami: environmental trajectory space: how environmental states move, fluctuate and reach extremes through admissible evolutionary transition windows
conceptual_novelty.cross_axis_test: ask whether the multivariate direction of historical environmental movement during a trait transition aligns with the present Azami trait-environment sorting vector

data_resolution.paleolocation: all available PALEO-PGEM cells within 21.5-25.6 N, 119.0-122.5 E; no single modern descendant coordinate
data_resolution.resolution_rule: report cellwise direction agreement and the ratio of regional spatial IQR to within-window temporal SD; do not promote a time signal when paleolocation uncertainty dominates

shared_space_time_core.reason: These are directly shared between the frozen Azami nine-predictor atlas and PALEO-PGEM-Series and therefore support a commensurate state-versus-trajectory comparison.
shared_space_time_core.selection_rule: retain all four variables in the cross-axis vector regardless of their individual Azami P values; do not select dimensions after observing the historical trajectory

orientation_wetting_mechanism.wet_side_meaning: precipitation of wettest month and wettest quarter; closer to episodic reproductive wetting exposure than annual precipitation
orientation_wetting_mechanism.dry_side_meaning: precipitation of driest month and driest quarter; negative-control contrast for a wet-exposure-specific explanation
orientation_wetting_mechanism.decision_logic: a rain/wetting mechanism is more specifically supported if the transition window is more exceptional on wet-side exposure than on dry-side precipitation under the same duration-matched null

secondary_not_primary.reason: These can be informative later, but they are not direct Azami shared axes; BIO18/BIO19 must not be called flowering-season precipitation without taxon-specific phenology.

not_directly_commensurate_with_paleo_pge.RSDS: Azami surface shortwave radiation has no direct PALEO-PGEM counterpart; orbital/astronomical forcing would be a separate model layer and is not equivalent to surface RSDS.
not_directly_commensurate_with_paleo_pge.VPD: PALEO-PGEM-Series does not provide the humidity information required for a directly comparable VPD history.
not_directly_commensurate_with_paleo_pge.sfcWind: no directly comparable wind series in the frozen PALEO-PGEM asset.
not_directly_commensurate_with_paleo_pge.GSP: could be derived only under an additional generic growing-season definition and is not taxon-specific flowering-season precipitation.
not_directly_commensurate_with_paleo_pge.NPP: requires an additional vegetation/productivity model and is not a direct PALEO-PGEM climatic state variable.

predeclared_estimands.shared_vector_concordance: cosine similarity between the Azami standardized among-taxon orientation beta vector for BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15 and the background-standardized historical change vector across the U-to-D event branch
predeclared_estimands.wetting_specificity: wet-side BIO13/BIO16 historical change/volatility relative to dry-side BIO14/BIO17 controls

nulls.time_window_null: all same-duration 320-kyr windows stepped every 10 kyr across the available 5-Myr series
nulls.trajectory_vector_null: cosine similarity computed for every same-duration background window using the same frozen Azami vector and variable standardization
nulls.wetting_specificity_null: wet-minus-dry contrast computed for every same-duration background window
nulls.current_limit: local climate-window null, not a full branch-opportunity/topology/age-posterior null

multiplicity_and_claim_gate.promotion_rule: historical alignment requires a predeclared tail result plus robustness to Taiwan cellwise paleolocation uncertainty; one local event cannot promote all Japan38 orientation history
multiplicity_and_claim_gate.negative_result_value: discordance between present spatial sorting and historical trajectory is retained as evidence that current ecological sorting need not identify the original transition driver

claim_boundary: No historical adaptation from state-trajectory concordance alone.
No equivalence between current niche centroid and ancestral environment.
No interpretation of BIO13/BIO16 as actual flower wetting without flowering-season exposure data.
No interpretation of 1-degree palaeoclimate as mountain microclimate.
No post hoc promotion of whichever PALEO-PGEM variable is most extreme.
